Responsibilities

This internship starts in summer 2027.

Interns in our Instrumentation and Controls group join a project team for a nuclear power plant client. You will help design control systems, review vendor documents and prepare calculations under the guidance of licensed engineers.

  • Prepare instrument data sheets and loop diagrams
  • Check design changes against plant standards
  • Take part in design reviews and client meetings

Qualifications

  • Studying electrical, mechanical or nuclear engineering, graduating in 2028 or 2029
  • Interest in the nuclear power industry
  • Good written communication and attention to detail

About Sargent & Lundy

Sargent & Lundy is an engineering firm serving power and energy clients for more than a century.
